title: Next.js 15 Pages Router supports React 18
condition: Pages Router. The Next.js 15.1 announcement explicitly says Pages Router continues to support React 18.
statement: Next.js 15 maintains backward compatibility for the Pages Router with React 18; Next.js 15.1 says Pages Router continues to support React 18 alongside React 19 stable.
sourceEvidence: Next.js 15 release: “Next.js 15 maintains backward compatibility for the Pages Router with React 18.” Next.js 15.1: Pages Router can use React 19 stable “alongside continued support for React 18.”

title: Next.js 15 App Router uses React 19 line
condition: App Router. Next.js 15.1 announced stable React 19 support in App Router.
statement: Next.js 15.1 states that React 19 stable is supported in both Pages Router and App Router.
sourceEvidence: Next.js 15.1 release notes: “Next.js 15.1 now fully supports React 19”; App Router includes React Canary with stable React 19 changes.

title: Next.js 16 upgrade installs latest React and React DOM
condition: Upgrade instructions recommend installing next@latest, react@latest, and react-dom@latest; guide does not state a precise React minimum in this section.
statement: The Next.js 16 upgrade guide instructs users to install the latest Next.js, React, and React DOM packages.
sourceEvidence: Manual upgrade command: `pnpm add next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest`; the guide does not give a concrete React version floor there.

title: React upgrade uses matching React and React DOM major
condition: React 19 installation path in the React 19 upgrade guide.
statement: The React 19 upgrade guide recommends installing React 19 and React DOM 19 together.

title: Node.js 18 support deprecated in Next.js 15.4
condition: When running Next.js 15.4 on the Node.js 18 line, Node.js 18 support is deprecated; this is not evidence that it has already been removed in 15.4.
sourceEvidence: Next.js 15.4 announcement highlights “Minor Deprecations and Changes: Deprecates Node.js 18 support.”

title: Proxy does not support Edge runtime in Next.js 16
condition: When migrating middleware to proxy, a proxy configured to use Edge runtime is unsupported.
statement: The Next.js 16 proxy runtime is Node.js and cannot be configured; Edge runtime is not supported in proxy.
sourceEvidence: The upgrade guide states: “The edge runtime is NOT supported in proxy. The proxy runtime is nodejs, and it cannot be configured.”
